description: This PHP class 'AccessFlowStateMachineService' provides services related to managing and querying workflow state transitions, roles, and actions within a human resource management system. It interacts with a DAO layer to retrieve and persist workflow state data, implements caching for efficiency, and offers methods for dynamic workflow management.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineService
classes.description: A service class providing workflow and state management functionalities related to access flows in the HRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO object for access flow state operations, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: setAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object for access flow state operations.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of allowed actions for a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Retrieves allowed workflow items for a specific workflow, state, and role, utilizing cache.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permitted within the workflow for a role and state.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Gets the next state after an action is performed in a workflow.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Fetches all allowed recruitment application states for a given workflow and role.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Retrieves states that are actionable based on the workflow, role, and proposed actions.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves workflow state machine records for a specific workflow and optional role.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a single workflow state machine record.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists an array of workflow state machine records.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on multiple identifying parameters.

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Returns a workflow state machine item by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow state machine item based on workflow, state, action, and role.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes workflow records associated with a specific user role and optional workflow.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Handles renaming of user roles and updates relevant workflow records.

methods.name: resetWorkflowCache
methods.description: Clears the cached list of allowed workflow items to refresh data.
